My entire stack costs $0/month:

Supabase — database, auth, storage
Resend — 3k emails (really 100/day)
Vercel — hosting + previews
GitHub Actions — cron jobs & automation
Cloudflare — DNS + caching
PostHog — 1M events
Sentry — 5k errors
Remotion — open source, renders my videos
